animations.name: cursor
animations.description: Blinking cursor animation for typewriter text effect in hero section, toggling opacity at 50% with 1.1s duration.

animations.name: marquee
animations.css: @keyframes marquee { 0% { transform: translate(0) } to { transform: translateX(var(--marquee-offset)) } }
animations.description: Horizontal scrolling animation for partner logo strips or continuous content loops.

animations.name: cursor-reveal
animations.css: @keyframes cursor-reveal { 0% { opacity: 0; scale: .5 } to { opacity: 1; scale: 1 } }
animations.description: Entry animation for cursor chat bubbles, scaling and fading in from center.

animations.name: cursor-exit
animations.css: @keyframes cursor-exit { 0% { opacity: 1; scale: 1 } to { opacity: 0; scale: .5 } }
animations.description: Exit animation for cursor chat bubbles, scaling and fading out to center.

animations.name: enter
animations.css: @keyframes enter { 0% { filter: blur(5px); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px) } }
animations.description: Scroll reveal entrance animation with blur, fade, and upward slide. Uses staggered delays via CSS custom property.

animations.name: terminal-chunk-in
animations.css: @keyframes terminal-chunk-in { 0% { opacity: 0; filter: blur(2px); transform: translateY(4px) } to { opacity: 1; filter: blur(); transform: translateY(0) } }
animations.description: Text chunk reveal animation for terminal-style content, with subtle blur and vertical slide.

animations.name: doc-video-playback
animations.css: @keyframes doc-video-playback { 0% { opacity: 0; scale: .8 } 20% { opacity: 1; scale: 1 } 80% { opacity: 1; scale: 1 } to { opacity: 0; scale: .8 } }
animations.description: Video playback indicator animation with scale and fade for documentation videos.

animations.name: btn-blue-transition
animations.description: Button state transition for blue gradient buttons with separate timing for background and transform.

animations.name: nav-transition
animations.description: Navigation bar background and shadow transition on scroll state change.

animations.name: link-opacity-transition
animations.description: Navigation link hover state opacity transition for subtle interaction feedback.

insights: The design system uses a distinctive 'paper' aesthetic with warm cream backgrounds (#FCFCF9) and ink-black typography (#181818), creating a print-inspired digital brutalist feel.
Navigation implements a transparent-to-solid pattern on scroll, with background color and shadow animating independently for smooth state transitions.
The embedded application mockup (PUI) uses extensive CSS custom properties for theming, enabling seamless light/dark mode switching with variables like --pui-chrome, --pui-text, and --pui-hairline.
